output.title: Single-namespace mode fix: controller arguments not shown
output.content: The fix concerns running cert-manager with `--namespace=<namespace>`, which limits scope to one namespace and disables cluster-scoped controllers. The environment includes an apps/v1 Deployment manifest, but the summary does not show its container arguments or whether this flag is set. Inspect the cert-manager Deployment args for `--namespace` to decide whether this fix changes behavior.
